settledConcerns.activationPredicate: The mounted receipt consumer runs only when the active transport for the match was created with expectedCampaignId equal to the mounted campaignId (transport.campaignId === campaignId) and that transport has latched receipt mode on an appliedView frame, which a server sends only when it composes applicationReceipts. In Task 13 no production creator binds expectedCampaignId (CampaignCoopEntryPanel.tsx 328, the component's two connectStoredCampaignSyncTransport calls, the mission launch page), and server.js does not compose applicationReceipts. Production joins therefore keep sending lastSeq, legacy frames keep the numeric observation ACK, and no confirmApplied runs. P2CF2 tests exercise the receipt path by registering a bound transport before mount; P2CF1 keeps the lastSeq omission on a bound join as P2CD shipped and tested it. Binding expectedCampaignId at the creators belongs to Task 14 together with composition; on a composed server the binder skips the lastSeq resync arm for application connections (bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts 1223), so the omission loses nothing there.
settledConcerns.refusalRouting: campaign-application-* refusals arrive as Error frames, code INVALID_INTENT, reason campaign-application-<kind> (bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts errorFrame). P2CF1's transport acts on them only on a receipt-mode connection: head-drift -> identical ACK re-send; unknown-receipt, not-offered, receipt-required, current-authority -> no re-send, view ends as recovery-required. P2CF2's component never stores a campaign-application-* Error in lastRefusalCode/lastRefusalAction, and those frames neither set nor clear the GM control gate; the consumer handles them (rejoin on recovery). INTERNAL_ERROR campaign-application-unavailable/replaced/send-failed/confirmation-failed close the socket and reach the consumer as a close, which also rejoins.
settledConcerns.componentSize: Sibling hook src/components/campaign/coop/useCampaignApplicationConsumer.ts is registered in P2CF2 (12 files with the reserved slot). It holds only new consumer code; moving existing component code into it would count those lines again under U41.
